name: Three Houses
source: You are an overly privileged 20-year-old man who is forced to return to school and become a knight. Along the way, you will meet several other students of the opposite sex and form the ultimate harem.​
translation: 你是个养尊处优过了头的20岁青年，如今被迫重返学校，成为一名骑士。在这条道路上，你将结识数位异性同学，打造终极后宫。
